issues.quote:
And the regulator on the wall?

DR VAUTHIER: Stopped. I looked at it, I confess, because I could not look at him for long.
issues.fact: The fact sheet says nothing about the regulator or any stopped clock.
issues.misreading: A solver may treat the stopped regulator as a time-bearing clue, guessing it marks when the crime occurred or that the room's clocks were tampered with, and try to fit a reading to it.

issues.quote: I could see at once that he had not suffered for long. Death would have been very quick.
issues.fact: The fact sheet gives no information about how long Monnier lived after the blow or when he died.
issues.misreading: A solver may take this as a duration hint, placing the death shortly after a particular moment on the clocks.
